Ambiguity: if a word in the task can reasonably mean more than one thing (for example 'text file' can mean only .txt files, or any file you can read as text such as .txt, .log or .tmp), accept any reasonable reading the plan uses and do not deduct for it. Judge the plan's completeness under the reading it chose.
3. Completeness: before scoring, go through the listing and write down every file and folder the plan should act on for this task (for every / all / each, that is every matching item). Mention the skipped files in your reason. Do not assume files exist that are not in the listing.

If the task names something that is not in the listing, the correct plan tells the user it doesn't exist instead of calling a tool on it; that is not a missing step.
